checks.scope: Leaf rules and phases duplicating engine-owned mechanics are targeted.
checks.observable: Compare the repeated contract with its named authoritative home.
checks.consistency: Consistent with DP-06 and the more specific entry-prompt rule.
checks.exceptions: Unique domain constraints and authoritative engine surfaces are excluded.
checks.fix: Fix the owner once and delete non-contributing restatements.
checks.expression: The no-domain-invariant test prevents removing substantive local guarantees.

entries.rationale: The rule supplies ownership and contribution tests; delivery must be established before applying deletion.

checks.scope: Prose that substitutes for declared binding resolution is the subject.
checks.observable: Remove the sentence and identify the unresolved binding or repeated mechanics.
checks.consistency: Input meaning remains separate from call-site remapping.
checks.exceptions: Binding owners, defaults and already-bound consumption are excluded.
checks.fix: Close the actual binding gap before deleting prose.
checks.expression: Obtain is qualified by bind resolution, not every act of deriving an output.

entries.rationale: The test distinguishes binding mechanics from domain production and names concrete structural remedies.

checks.scope: Input and Output descriptions carrying procedure are explicitly named.
checks.observable: Imperatives, sequencing and recovery duties expose misplaced work.
checks.consistency: Recognition criteria stay in Outputs under DP-13/AP-111.
checks.exceptions: Defaults, value shape and recognition predicates are appropriately excluded.
checks.fix: Move work into Protocol or cross-cutting Rules while retaining the contract.
checks.expression: What the value is versus how to produce it is a workable qualitative test.

entries.rationale: The boundaries and exceptions resolve the principal contract-versus-procedure ambiguity.

checks.scope: Capability procedure, foreign links and designators are precisely enumerated.
checks.observable: Both semantic procedure and mechanical text forms are inspectable.
checks.consistency: A stricter field-purity convention can coexist with DP-13.
checks.exceptions: Plain products and container contributions are allowed.
checks.fix: Move operational detail to Protocol, Rules or I/O.
checks.expression: The title is narrower than the body, but the intended prohibited forms are explicit.

entries.rationale: This is an explicit local expression convention; disagreeing with its strictness alone is not a canon defect.

checks.scope: Standing constraints encoded as sequenced phases are targeted.
checks.observable: Removing the step without changing the sequence is a concrete test.
checks.consistency: Moving inherited duties to Rules creates AP-143's defect.
checks.exceptions: Work phases and local caveats are usefully excluded.
checks.fix: Add deletion for already-delivered duties before relocating unique invariants.
checks.expression: Follow rules throughout is not always a new invariant needing another home.

entries.rationale: Distinguish unique misplaced constraints from redundant reminders.

checks.scope: Entry stubs restating owned delivery/binding mechanics are targeted.
checks.observable: Deletion plus a citation must preserve fidelity, including reach.
checks.consistency: That explicit test can coexist with DP-33's standalone bootstrap.
checks.exceptions: Minimal stubs, new duties and role boundaries are differentiated.
checks.fix: Remove only a redundant statement after its owner remains available.
checks.expression: Preserves fidelity is qualitative but directly testable with the delivered text.

entries.rationale: A pre-session instruction whose removal breaks execution fails the Detect test and must remain available.

checks.scope: Capability inventories of child operations or folders are targeted.
checks.observable: A child rename/addition requiring a prose update exposes roster coupling.
checks.consistency: Matches DP-27's contribution statement and DP-34's edit-owner stance.
checks.exceptions: Stable purpose clauses, leaf products and README indexes are exempt.
checks.fix: State the domain and link discovery through the actual index.
checks.expression: The folder-equivalence test makes the contribution-versus-roster distinction concrete.

entries.rationale: The entry is specific enough to apply without arbitrary length limits.
